title: fix(components): header-action predicates wait for the record instead of reporting "No such key"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9E8CzBpSUdLhr9L1Yhzma3U)_
Fixes #33987

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录页头部按钮的 `visible` / `hidden` / `disabled` / `pressed` 条件，在记录还没加载完时不再求值，也不再往控制台报错；记录到了再正常求值。
- 为什么改：页面一打开就拿一条空记录去算条件，每个 `record.status` 这类条件都报 “No such key… check the field names and CEL”，让作者去改其实没错的元数据。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `page:header` 一个组件；加载中各条件取各自的安全默认值（隐藏 / 不隐藏 / 禁用 / 未按下），与之前出错时的取值一致，记录到了以后行为不变。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` 的 `headerRecordPending` 与 `evalHeaderPredicate`；再看 `page-header-predicate-dialect.test.tsx` 末尾新增的一组测试。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-predicate-dialect.test.tsx`，预期 33 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A record page binds its record id at once and its row only when the read answers (`RecordDetailView` hands `data: null` until then; `RecordContextValue.data` is documented as "undefined while loading"). `page:header` evaluated its action predicates against `ctx?.data ?? {}`, so during that window every `record.FIELD` predicate faulted with "No such key", and the warn-once fault report (keyed by label and predicate) told the author to check the field names of a field the object has, on every page load.

- `headerRecordPending` names the state: a record context is present, it carries a record id, and its row is `null`/`undefined`.
- `evalHeaderPredicate` answers each key's own fallback while pending and evaluates nothing, so nothing is reported. All four call sites (`visible`, `hidden`, `disabled`, `pressed`) go through it.
- `disabledReasonFor` gives no "Not available for this record" reason while pending: the closed `disabled` fallback is not a fact about a record that has not arrived. Same defect class (a pending record reported as a fact about the record), same file, same gate families.
- Unchanged: a header with no record bound (no context, or no id) still evaluates, so a `record.*` predicate there still faults and says so; a loaded record that really lacks the key still warns once.

No change in `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/**`: the evaluator is right to fault on an empty record; the root cause is the caller spelling an absent record as an empty one.

## Tests

One new top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness `page-header-predicate-dialect.test.tsx` (no new file):

- pending → no fault report, `visible` answers hidden; record arrives → predicate honoured (shown), still no report;
- loaded negative direction → hidden, no report;
- pending `hidden` / `disabled` / `pressed` → rendered, disabled, `aria-pressed="false"`, no `aria-describedby` reason, no report; after load → enabled, pressed, no report;
- CONTROL: a loaded record missing `f_status` → hidden and exactly one fault naming `f_status`;
- CONTROL: no record id bound → still faults once.

No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- Triage asked whether the rendered buttons are wrong after the record loads. Measured on the shipped code (fix ablated, same harness): pending `[false,false]` with 2 fault reports; after load `[true,false]`, which is the predicates' own verdict. So only the pre-load pass was wrong; the authored rule was already honoured once the record arrived. With the fix: pending `[false,false]`, 0 reports; loaded `[true,false]`, 0 reports.
- While pending, a predicate that reads only the host scope (for example `ctx.user.isPlatformAdmin == true`) also waits for the record, where it used to evaluate at once. The header shows its record-gated and user-gated actions together, once the row arrives.

## Verification

- `headerRecordPending` forced to `false`: 3 of the 5 new tests red (`expected [ Array(1) ] to have a length of +0 but got 1` on both pending fault-count pins; the legs test red on `aria-describedby`); both CONTROL tests stay green.
- only the `disabledReasonFor` pending line deleted: 1 red (the legs test, `aria-describedby`).

</details>
